state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `whoami`, `read`, `add`, `authenticate`, `modify`, `delete`, `rename`, `setPassword`, `changePassword`, `compare` and `Entry::isDeleted` owe nothing, perf included.

**Seven `Core\Ldap` features still owe everything.** `bun nv proofs --owed --limit 1000 | grep -i ldap` lists them: `Connection::search` and `changes` (about, examples, hostile, perf, tests), `LdapError` (about, examples, hostile, tests), and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope` and `Ad\AccountType` (about, examples, tests). `bun nv proofs --gate` prints only its first 30 lines, so read the full list there and never the driver's one-line summary.

**The whole-roster check also counts features outside this goal.** Most of what `bun nv proofs --gate` names is `Core\Str` stale perf, `lang` and `Core\Db`. The check `dossier-the-whole-roster-owes-nothing-with-core-ldap` in `data/goals/ldap.json` cannot pass from `Core\Ldap` work alone.

**Two blocks reach `samba-ad`.** `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader` (`whoami` returns `u:EXAMPLE\Reader`) and is granted by directory to every `Ldap-*` tree. `[ldap.corp-accounts]` binds as `Administrator` and is granted only to the write proofs' directories and bench files, by a nested `[[app]] root` or `entry` in the root `nvs.toml`. `search` and `changes` only read, so `[ldap.corp]` serves them with no new grant. An `[[app]] root` that names a missing directory fails every program with `E0605`. Check a draft with `bun nv proofs --run --id '<feature>' --show`.

**Samba is slow on logins and stalls under parallel writes.** One `authenticate` takes about 2.3 s against `samba-ad`, a failed one about as long, so a proof keeps its logins to a dozen. A write bench run beside a write attack can hit the block's 5 s timeout; `--record-perf --only <id>` alone succeeds. `read("")` returns the server's root entry, not `null`.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** people are `CN=Anna Berg`, `CN=Ben Kohl`, `CN=Carla Diaz` and `CN=Dora Lind` under `OU=Company`, plus `CN=Reader`. Anna Berg and Carla Diaz are in `Sales`. The domain's short name is `EXAMPLE`.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap\Connection::search` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:423` and its card at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:588`. Tests are `covers:` markers: `tests/conformance/core/ldap-connect-and-search.nvst:4` and a Rust test that calls `ldap::search`, such as `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:243`. It reads, so `[ldap.corp]` and the existing `Ldap-Connection` grant serve it.

**`Core\Ldap\Connection::changes` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): its row is at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:435`; `tests/conformance/core/ldap-sync-cookie.nvst:4` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs:2264` take a `covers:` marker. DirSync may need the `corp-accounts` grant if `Reader` lacks the replication right; check with `--run --show` first.

backlog: `LdapError` and the enums `ErrorKind`, `Tls`, `Scope`, `Ad\AccountType` owe their proofs (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`); the enums owe about, examples and tests only.
One `authenticate` takes about 2.3 s, perf record in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`; whether the time is Samba's bind or the client's close in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/mod.rs:569` is not checked.

In `tests/hostile/core/Ldap-Connection/authenticate/01-guess-logins-and-passwords.nvs` step 2, one of the three bad passwords is accepted; which one, and whether a password with a zero byte should throw before it is sent, is not checked.
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies to `Ldap::open`. Stage 6: the schema wired into the readers.
